title: Enerthya Host v0.12.13
subtitle: Invite a teammate, and a shell inside the container

slides.title: What changed
slides.body:
- invite by address, with a role
- change a role, remove a member
- the invite email leaves through your relay
- a shell inside the running container

slides.title: The rule that did not change
slides.body:
A deploy is done when the health check passes,
not when the process starts.
